kind: MEASUREMENT DEFECT found in run v1, after v1 scores were seen. v1 is retained unmutated.

defect.what: the B_onset baseline was misaligned by 2 hops (64 ms) against the causal grid
defect.declared_mapping_in_the_script: our frame i maps to librosa onset_strength index i - (n_fft/hop - 1) = i - 3
defect.why_that_was_wrong: librosa.onset.onset_strength internally takes a first difference of the mel spectrogram, which shifts its effective frame reference. The naive window-arithmetic mapping does not account for that.
defect.how_it_was_caught: the receipt's own onset-vs-flux alignment diagnostic returned Spearman 0.155 - implausibly low for two energy-change measures computed on the same grid from the same audio. That number is in the v1 receipt and is what triggered the check.

measurement.test: Spearman(onset_strength shifted by k, 1-hop rectified flux over host_spectrogram80), 6 tracks

what_v1_results_it_contaminates: M_tv_from_acoustic_energy_set (0.1444) and M_tv_from_all_four (0.3288) - both include B_onset
what_v1_results_it_does_NOT_contaminate: HARMONIC_CHANGE_FLAT_ENERGY (2299 frames) - uses B_rms, not onset

v1_outcome_stands.reason_1: the inherited alignment rule fired: chroma-movement argmax lag -1 with margin 0.0229 over lag 0, above the 0.02 tolerance
v1_outcome_stands.note: the two reasons are independent and both point the same way: v1 issues no verdict.

repair_and_its_boundary.what_is_being_fixed: a measurement bug in a baseline, empirically located against an independent baseline (rectified flux), not against the target M_tv - so it cannot bias the result toward the hypothesis
repair_and_its_boundary.direction_of_the_correction: conservative. Better onset alignment makes onset ranks MORE accurate, which can only REDUCE spurious HARMONIC_CHANGE_NO_ONSET frames.
what_is_NOT_being_changed: the inherited chroma lag rule (still |argmax| >= 2 hops or margin > 0.02)
the construct, the metrics, the lag, the percussion exclusion
repair_and_its_boundary.disclosure: v1 scores WERE seen before this repair. v2 is therefore a post-hoc re-run and is labelled as such. Captain decides whether v2 counts.
